title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission and restricted…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where users with System Settings edit permission and restricted tenant access can modify settings of tenants outside their scope via the REST API. This flaw arises because the Tenant REST API verifies the edit permission but fails to enforce tenant restrictions, allowing unauthorized access to tenant configurations. Exploitation could lead to exposure of confidential tenant data, unauthorized changes to tenant settings and automation, or disruption of tenant operations.
